title: The Legend of Zelda: Spirit Tracks

roms.name: USA with the D-pad control patch (as tested)

notes: Same engine family as Phantom Hourglass: all assets are standard Nitro files in NARC archives. Textures are paired with their materials' palettes and those palettes' animation families (zeld_eye1 also brings zeld_eye2 and zeld_eye3, which the blink animation swaps in).
Only the D-pad patched ROM has been tested. The retail ROM should give the same keys wherever the patch didn't touch the graphics; run it and compare the counts with the baseline.
Fonts: DSZ2_msg (dialogue), DSZ2_endL / DSZ2_endS (credits) and LC_Font_s_Name are packed for HD text.

Scenes that fade or tint by rewriting palettes (the opening demo's dark start) look native until the palette is back to normal: the pack key hashes the palette, so a faded palette has no key. Measured on the opening: 196 of 200 logged texture misses were this.

verified.on_device: AYN Thor, opening demo: 29965 pack entries indexed, BG tiles 92160/92160 lookups hit, the train, sky and Link in HD; textures drawn with faded palettes stay native (see notes)
